links.outcome: Clinician trust, confidence, and behavioral influence with narrative explanations versus control
links.effect: No trust change; narrative explanations gave greater confidence change vs control (P = .024) and numeric confidence (P = .0051); control group showed higher behavioral influence than transparency conditions (P = .0006).
links.quote: Confidence increased following any AI assistance (+6.7%), but narrative explanations were associated with greater change in confidence compared with both control (P = .024) and numeric confidence (P = .0051).
